requirements.text: A completed task must have a compact user-facing completion report that summarizes changes, checks, validation/publication proof, archive/restore refs, remaining risks, and next action.
The task-close/publisher flow should generate or link the completion report and expose the report path or summary when closure completes, with gradual compatibility to avoid blocking legacy tasks.

summary: Accepted user-facing task completion report requirement.

diff_table.current_state: Task closure records evidence in roadmap archive rows, implementation_build.closure_brief, validation reports, commits, and chat summaries, but CodeWiki has no canonical user-facing completion report artifact or standard display contract at task finish.
diff_table.desired_state: When a task finishes, CodeWiki should produce a compact user-facing completion report that summarizes what changed, evidence/checks, validation/publication proof, archive/restore refs, remaining risks, and recommended next action.
diff_table.rationale: Users need a durable end-of-task report instead of hunting through build, validation, commit, graph, and roadmap archive refs. Existing closure_brief is close but buried inside implementation builds and not sufficient as the task-finish output surface.
diff_table.risk: Could duplicate closure_brief/validation data unless report is derived from canonical refs and clearly non-canonical.
alternatives: Expose implementation_build.closure_brief directly without a new report contract.
Keep chat-only summaries and rely on validation/build refs for durable evidence.

diff_table.current_state: Roadmap close and task-close validation can succeed without requiring a rendered end-user report or storing a completion report reference in task closure evidence.
diff_table.desired_state: Task-close/publisher flow should generate or link the completion report before final closure, and the close response should surface the report path/summary to the user.
diff_table.rationale: Making the report part of closure flow ensures every finished task has consistent user-visible output and avoids forgetting the final explanation after long compiler/publisher loops.
diff_table.risk: If enforced too early, existing tasks may block closure. Use compatibility/gradual adoption first.
alternatives: Make completion reports optional for high-risk/long tasks only.
Generate report only in adapter/UI layer after closure, without blocking task-close.

accepted_decisions.summary: Add a compact user-facing task completion report artifact/surface at task finish.
Integrate completion report generation/linking into task-close/publisher flow and surface it to the user.

assumptions: Completion reports should be derived from canonical build, validation, roadmap, and commit/archive refs to avoid duplicate truth.
non_goals: Do not make legacy closed tasks fail because they lack a completion report.
Do not replace validation reports or commits as proof.
